description:
Search open jobs across ~24,000 companies at once - no company list needed.

Reads a daily index of every live public board on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby,
Workday, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee, Teamtailor, Breezy HR and Personio.
Jobs from the latest daily completed index (about 1.4 million records in the current build), at most 3 per company for variety. Results do not include descriptions. The index is a broad coverage snapshot, not an exhaustive real-time feed.

- keywords: comma-separated title terms, any may match, matched at word start
  ("engineer" matches "Engineering Manager"; "AI" does not match "maintain").
- exclude: comma-separated title terms to drop, e.g. "senior, intern".
- location: comma-separated substrings of the job location, e.g. "Berlin, Germany".
  "remote" also accepts remote roles.
- remote: true keeps only remote roles.
- posted_within_days: only jobs first published in the last N days.
- ats: limit to vendors, e.g. "greenhouse,ashby".
- company: substring of the company name.
- limit: 1-50 (default 20).

Returns title, company, location, remote, posted_at, url, ats, ats_handle and
`matched` (total matches). Use search_jobs(vendor=ats, handle=ats_handle) to get
live data and descriptions for one company.
name: search_all_jobs
